supportChangeRequirements: project properties that intentionally enable or declare the deployment mode

trim.summary: Trimming is not part of the current Cephalon support contract.

nativeAot.summary: Native AOT is not part of the current Cephalon support contract.

singleFile.summary: Single-file publishing is not part of the current Cephalon support contract.

representativePublishTargets.comment: List the smallest set of csproj paths the harness should publish to honestly prove a claim. The harness defaults to this list when -PublishTargets is not passed and -SkipPublish is not set; pass -SkipPublish to force audit-only mode. Each target is published once per deployment mode (trim / nativeAot / singleFile); the audit-only verdict reports warnings but does not fail the build because the manifest still declares all three modes as not-claimed.

deploymentModeEligibility.comment: Per-package eligibility table seeded from docs/trim-aot-hazard-inventory.md. Originally introduced via ENG-426 (high + first medium-tier seeding); broadened via ENG-432 (Cephalon.Behaviors.Http reclassified low->medium with three additional reflection sites), ENG-433 (Cephalon.Data added at medium tier under broadened MakeGenericMethod / BindingFlags pattern set), ENG-434 (Cephalon.Data.MySql added at high tier + Cephalon.Data.Postgres / Cephalon.Data.Oracle added at medium tier for the CDC capture services), ENG-435 (Cephalon.Abstractions added at low tier + two enum-extension hazard sites appended to Cephalon.Behaviors.Http), ENG-436 (six additional knownHazards entries appended to Cephalon.Behaviors covering the BehaviorModule.cs two-phase auto-registration pipeline + the BehaviorExecutionSlot.cs open-generic execution-slot dispatch — package tier unchanged at high, hazard list grows), ENG-437 (seven additional knownHazards entries appended to Cephalon.Behaviors.Http covering RestBehaviorProjection.cs reflective method lookup + open-generic dispatch, RestBehaviorModuleBuilder.cs IBehaviorModuleBuilder.Add overload selection + open-generic dispatch, and BehaviorRestProfileResolver.cs phase-1 ContainsBehaviorsAttribute.RegistrationType reflective enumerators — package tier unchanged at medium, hazard list grows from 6 to 13), ENG-438 (Cephalon.ReferenceDocs added at high tier with a permanent not-claimed posture — the published documentation generator performs by-design type-introspection of arbitrary referenced assemblies, so the high-tier remediation alternative "document a permanent not-claimed posture for that package" is the durable answer rather than a structural rewrite — closing the last item in the original ENG-433 not-yet-classified callout), ENG-439 (Cephalon.ReferenceDocs csproj posture uplift — declared IsTrimmable=false / IsAotCompatible=false / PublishTrimmed=false / PublishAot=false / PublishSingleFile=false in src/Cephalon.ReferenceDocs/Cephalon.ReferenceDocs.csproj and seeded the matching requiredProjectProperties array in this manifest entry, so the harness's project-property audit phase can confirm the permanent posture in machine-checkable form), ENG-454 (schema 1.2.0 package-scoped claim pilot — Cephalon.Diagnostics is the first clean-baseline package with supportedModes=[singleFile] and required project properties that the harness treats as scoped support rather than global support drift), ENG-456 (retired all nine REST wire-name enum-field reflection helpers by replacing attribute reflection with closed switch mappings; Cephalon.Abstractions returned to clean-baseline absence from this table and Cephalon.Behaviors.Http dropped the two enum-extension hazards while retaining its medium-tier dispatch hazards), ENG-457 (Cephalon.Behaviors.SourceGen now emits execution-slot hints and Cephalon.Behaviors prefers them for source-generated dispatch startup, while this manifest also records the new GetExecutionSlots carrier-method lookup and keeps the package at high because generated carrier lookups plus runtime discovery fallback remain), ENG-458 (Cephalon.Behaviors.SourceGen now emits closed durable-execution slots and Cephalon.Behaviors.Patterns prefers them for source-generated durable strategy/catalog paths, while the existing package row stays high because DurableExecutionSlot.ForType remains as the runtime-discovery fallback), ENG-459 (Cephalon.Data.MySql now projects hosted-service capture failure metadata through a typed internal failure-metadata contract instead of duck-typed property reflection, while the package stays high because the SciSharp ReplicationClient non-public adapter remains), ENG-460 (Cephalon.Data.Postgres and Cephalon.Data.Oracle now project CDC hosted-service capture failure metadata through provider-local typed internal contracts, removing the remaining duck-typed CDC exception metadata rows), and ENG-461 (the Cephalon.EventSourcing provider family now persists stable registry event-type names and resolves legacy names through EventTypeDescriptor aliases, removing all ten persisted Type.GetType rows). Each entry records the package's claim-audit tier, the actual reflection / dynamic-code call sites observed in its src/Cephalon.* source as of May 6, 2026, and the supportedModes that are explicitly scoped to that package. Entries with empty supportedModes do not claim a mode. The global manifest claim stays not-claimed until project properties + harness verdicts move for the whole engine support story. Packages absent from this table remain clean-baseline but unclaimed unless they are added here deliberately. Excluded-by-design analyzer / source-generator projects are listed separately so the harness can confirm their disable-properties remain in place.

packages.evidence: docs/trim-aot-hazard-inventory.md (clean-baseline tier — no observed first-party reflection / dynamic-code hazards; package-scoped single-file claim added via ENG-454)

knownHazards.pattern: Activator.CreateInstance(moduleType, nonPublic: true)
knownHazards.remediation: Replace assembly-scanned module discovery with a compile-time module manifest emitted by a source generator that registers IModule descriptors at startup.

knownHazards.pattern: Runtime registry keyed by Type with late-bound resolution from descriptors
knownHazards.remediation: Replace runtime type registry with a compile-time descriptor + source-generator-emitted registration table; behaviors register via generated code rather than reflective discovery.

knownHazards.pattern: regType.GetMethod("Register", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, [typeof(IServiceCollection), typeof(IBehaviorTypeRegistry)], null) — phase-1 reflective lookup of the source-gen-emitted Register helper on ContainsBehaviorsAttribute.RegistrationType (matching Invoke on line 356)
knownHazards.remediation: Annotation-recoverable in isolation via [DynamicallyAccessedMembers(PublicMethods | NonPublicMethods)] on ContainsBehaviorsAttribute.RegistrationType; package tier still gated by the phase-2 assembly-scan fallback below, so the structural fix is the same source-gen-emitted compile-time module manifest that retires BehaviorTypeRegistry.

knownHazards.pattern: regType.GetMethod("GetExecutionSlots", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null) — phase-1 reflective lookup of the source-gen-emitted execution-slot enumerator (matching Invoke on line 365)
knownHazards.remediation: Same annotation-recovery + structural fix as the line-350 entry; this carrier lookup enables source-generated dispatch slots but remains a deployment-mode hazard until generated carrier methods move behind a compile-time manifest contract.

knownHazards.pattern: regType.GetMethod("GetTopologyDescriptors", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null) — phase-1 reflective lookup of the source-gen-emitted topology-descriptor enumerator (matching Invoke on line 390)
knownHazards.remediation: Same annotation-recovery + structural fix as the line-350 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: regType.GetMethod("GetBehaviorsNeedingRuntimeTopology", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null) — phase-1 reflective lookup of the source-gen-emitted runtime-topology enumerator (matching Invoke on line 422)
knownHazards.remediation: Same annotation-recovery + structural fix as the line-350 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: assembly.DefinedTypes.Select(ti => ti.AsType()).ToArray() then Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(type, typeof(AppBehaviorAttribute)) plus type.GetInterfaces().FirstOrDefault(i => i.IsGenericType && i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IAppBehavior<,>)) — phase-2 reflection-fallback assembly scan over every type in the assembly
knownHazards.remediation: Source-gen-emitted compile-time module manifest that enumerates behaviors at build time, retiring both the assembly scan here and the BehaviorTypeRegistry runtime registry. Annotation alone is not sufficient — this is the dominant high-tier driver in the file.

knownHazards.pattern: behaviorType.GetMethod("ConfigureTopology", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy, null, [typeof(IBehaviorTopologyBuilder)], null) — reflective lookup of the optional static ConfigureTopology helper on each behavior type (matching Invoke on line 532)
knownHazards.remediation: Reachable from both phase-1 and phase-2; the phase-2 reach makes it high. Removed by the same source-gen-emitted module manifest that retires the assembly scan and BehaviorTypeRegistry.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(BehaviorExecutionSlot).GetMethod(nameof(For), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)!.MakeGenericMethod(behaviorType, tIn, tOut) followed by forMethod.Invoke(null, null) (line 76) — open-generic method dispatch over the (behaviorType, TInput, TOutput) triple drawn from the runtime registry; after ENG-457 this is the fallback path for behaviors without generated execution-slot hints
knownHazards.remediation: ENG-457 moved source-generated dispatch startup to generated closed generic For<TBehavior, TInput, TOutput>() slots. Remaining remediation is to retire the fallback by replacing runtime discovery and BehaviorTypeRegistry with a source-gen-emitted compile-time module manifest; high here (rather than medium like BehaviorRestEndpointGroup.cs:486) because fallback behaviorType values can still be sourced from the assembly-scanned registry.

packages.evidence: docs/trim-aot-hazard-inventory.md (high tier — additional Cephalon.Behaviors evidence appended via ENG-436: module-discovery pipeline + open-generic execution-slot dispatch; execution-slot generated fast path plus GetExecutionSlots carrier lookup recorded via ENG-457)

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(DurableExecutionSlot).GetMethod(nameof(For), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)!.MakeGenericMethod(behaviorType, typeArguments[0], typeArguments[1], typeArguments[2]) + forMethod.Invoke(null, null)
knownHazards.remediation: Source-gen-emitted closed-generic durable slot registration keyed by behavior implementation so the four-arg generic shape (TBehavior, TInput, TState, TOutput) is materialized at compile time for generated behaviors; the row remains until the runtime-discovery ForType fallback is retired or made explicitly annotated.

packages.evidence: docs/trim-aot-hazard-inventory.md (high tier; ENG-458 moved normal source-generated durable execution onto closed DurableExecutionSlot registrations while retaining the fallback hazard)

knownHazards.remediation: Either an upstream SciSharp.MySQL.Replication API surface change that opens these members, or a fully public re-implementation of the binlog transport against the public API; annotation alone cannot reach across an external compiled assembly.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy) — resolver behind the SetupConnection static MethodInfo field (line 25)
knownHazards.remediation: Same upstream-API or public-rewrite path as the line-1177 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetField(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic) — resolver behind 3 static FieldInfo fields (lines 26-28: _connection, _serverId, _stream)
knownHazards.remediation: Same upstream-API or public-rewrite path; non-public fields on a third-party type cannot be preserved by trim/AOT analyzers.

knownHazards.pattern: method.Invoke(instance, arguments) over the resolved third-party non-public methods
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same upstream-API or public-rewrite that retires the GetMethod/GetField calls above; trim-hostile because the resolved methods themselves can be stripped from the third-party assembly.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetConstructors(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static constructors of any type the generator is asked to document, used to emit per-constructor MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Permanent not-claimed posture for the package (the high-tier remediation alternative). The package's purpose is type-introspection of arbitrary referenced assemblies, so a source-generator-emitted descriptor table cannot replace this reflection without removing the package's reason to exist. A future slice may declare IsTrimmable=false; IsAotCompatible=false; PublishTrimmed=false; PublishAot=false; PublishSingleFile=false in the csproj to make the permanent posture machine-checkable through the harness's project-property audit phase.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static fields, used to emit per-field MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-295 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static properties, used to emit per-property MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-295 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static methods, used to emit per-method MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-295 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: GetRequiredCoreMethod calls typeof(BehaviorRestEndpointGroup).GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static) for five MapBehavior{Delete,Get,Patch,Post,Put}Core helpers
knownHazards.remediation: Replace with direct method references once the source-gen rewrite of MakeGenericMethod (line 486) is in place — the generator owns the per-verb dispatch and removes the need for runtime MethodInfo indirection.

knownHazards.pattern: coreMethod.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(TBehavior), contract.InputType, contract.OutputType)
knownHazards.remediation: Source-gen-emitted dispatch table keyed by behavior identity that materializes the closed generic method per (TBehavior, TInput, TOutput) triple at compile time. This is the dominant hazard in the file.

knownHazards.pattern: (RouteHandlerBuilder)closedMethod.Invoke(null, [this, pattern, contract])!
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same source-gen rewrite that retires the MakeGenericMethod call above; the generated closed-generic helpers can be invoked directly without MethodInfo.Invoke.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ResultModel<>).MakeGenericType(contract.ResponseType)
knownHazards.remediation: Same source-gen rewrite emits the closed ResultModel<TResponse> directly off the profile-contract list, retiring this MakeGenericType call.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(RestBehaviorEndpointProjection).GetMethod(nameof(CreateMapDelegateFactory), BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic) initializing static readonly MethodInfo CreateMapDelegateFactoryMethod (anchor BindingFlags on line 43)
knownHazards.remediation: Replace with a direct method reference once the per-projection source-gen path retires CreateMapDelegate — the same source-gen-emitted dispatch table that retires BehaviorRestEndpointGroup.cs:486.

knownHazards.pattern: CreateMapDelegateFactoryMethod.MakeGenericMethod(behaviorType) followed by closedMethod.Invoke(null, [method]) (line 208) — open-generic method dispatch over runtime behaviorType to materialize a per-behavior map-delegate factory
knownHazards.remediation: Source-gen-emitted dispatch table keyed by behavior identity that materializes the closed generic CreateMapDelegateFactory<TBehavior> at compile time — same shape as the BehaviorRestEndpointGroup.cs:486 remediation.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(IBehaviorModuleBuilder).GetMethods().Single(static method => method.Name == nameof(IBehaviorModuleBuilder.Add) && method.IsGenericMethodDefinition && method.GetParameters().Length == 1) initializing static readonly MethodInfo AddOwnedBehaviorWithTopologyMethod

knownHazards.remediation: Source-gen-emitted dispatch table keyed by behavior identity that materializes the closed generic Add<TBehavior> at compile time — same shape as the BehaviorRestEndpointGroup.cs:486 remediation.

knownHazards.pattern: registrationType.GetMethod("GetRestProfileBehaviorTypes", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, binder: null, Type.EmptyTypes, modifiers: null) followed by method?.Invoke(null, null) (line 196) — phase-1 reflective lookup of the source-gen-emitted REST-profile-behavior-types enumerator

knownTransitiveHazards.comment: Known third-party packages that emit trim or AOT warnings even when the consuming Cephalon.* project itself looks clean. Listed for reference; the harness does not currently fail on these but reports them in the per-target warnings list so the operator can see the source.
singleFile: Plugins or providers that load assemblies dynamically at runtime
